answer_1.quote: We introduce OCEANGPT, the first-ever LLM in the ocean domain, which is expert in various ocean science tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses to ocean science-related instructions, including question answering, description, extraction, code for robot control, and more, demonstrating expertise in oceanography and preliminary embodied intelligence.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance and reduce reliance on manual evaluation, we leverage GPT-4 as the evaluator.

answer_4.quote: To validate our proposed framework, we also collect the output data in different settings and evaluate it by human evaluation. We employ 5 students with an ocean science background as human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: For each evaluation setting, we sample a set of 200 examples and human annotators will rank the outputs they prefer.
